acceptance.criterion_verbatim: TRAVIS-CLASS DELTA PRINTED, measured and explained.
acceptance.invocation: same invocation, SPOTLIGHT 'Travis Penfield' block; plus the candidate-mechanism battery (export Account MV vs our net_mv_plus_cash / net_mv_positions / +Cash Market Value) over the 284 matched accounts
acceptance.output_evidence: HEADLINE PRINTED: L1 - L3 = $79,366,493.25 (+21.03%). Decomposed into NAMED components, each measured: (i) MEMBERSHIP L1-L2 = $64,243,548.90 (BD's group carries 347 members vs the export's 318; CRO measured 28 accounts/$42.9M dropped by the export's open/grouped filters + 12 non-Schwab/$16.1M invisible to Schwab-only feeds; plus the qt6-EMV accrual+cash-inclusive basis component); (ii) COVERAGE L2-L3 = $25,250,660.86 across 34 export members absent from our canonical, ALL 34 reading Account Is Open = true so not a closed-account artifact, largest $6.15M/$3.70M/$3.30M/$2.97M/$2.00M; (iii) VALUATION on the 284 both sides carry = -$10,127,716.51, and the battery shows this is MOSTLY A MEASURE MISMATCH: export Account MV ties our net_mv_positions at -$599,023.78 (-0.163%) vs -2.683% against net_mv_plus_cash, and adding the export's separate Cash Market Value makes the fit WORSE (+1.160%). (i)+(ii)+(iii) close arithmetically ((a)+(b) == L2-L3 verified True). ALSO CORRECTED A CIRCULATING NUMBER: CRO's $405.4M 'allocation-export census' reproduces byte-for-byte as the RAW ROW SUM and double-counts $12.8M across 9 accounts sitting under 2+ portfolios inside one group; correct membership figure is $392,556,451.10. Attribute view retained and printed (architect 233 accts $316,280,384.19 unweighted / $122,500,856.99 split-weighted; ANY-ROLE union 241 / $348,726,019.90). NOT conflated with B_02: Andrew's NET/REAL valuation ruling @a3da94f467 is a different question, cited not re-derived. UNAFFECTED BY THE 2245Z SLEEVE CORRECTION: Travis Penfield is not one of the 12 groups that moved; every figure in this row is identical before and after. *** FULL-POPULATION RESULT (2026-08-19 ~2320Z), AND IT RESTATES THE HEADLINE *** Travis now reads L1 $456,773,323.40 vs L3 $377,433,506.75 = +$79,339,816.65 (+21.02%); nothing material moved from the relayed-value run. BUT AT FULL POPULATION TRAVIS IS NOT AN OUTLIER AND +21% IS NOT THE STORY: across 199 groups the pct L1-vs-L3 distribution is min -0.01 / Q1 +10.28 / MEDIAN +29.11 / Q3 +51.11 / max +117,808.82, so Travis sits BELOW the median gap. BD reads higher on 174 groups, lower on 2, EXACTLY EQUAL on 24. THE DECOMPOSITION IS DECISIVE: summed across the population the MEMBERSHIP component (L1-L2) is $1,895,250,943.97 and the VALUATION component (L2-L3) is $191,302,323.96 -- membership is 90.8% of the total gap and dominates in 153 of 199 groups (77%). (Component sums over overlapping groups: a ratio, never a book figure.) THE 24 EXACT TIES ARE THE STRONGEST EVIDENCE IN THE RUN: BD's own EMV equals our net_mv_plus_cash TO THE CENT on 24 groups, two fully independent engines with no shared derivation, and in 22 of 24 the export roster is complete (matched == member_accounts); on those same groups the export's Account Market Value disagrees by $1,964,099.38 -- independently corroborating the positions-grain finding from a different direction. The tail agrees from the other end: the 20 widest groups average an L1/L2 ratio of 20.08x while the exact-tie groups average 5.3 member accounts. CONCLUSION: our chain's VALUATION is not the problem; the daily export's ROSTER is narrower than BD's own group definition -- the same root as the dim-436 gap, and one vendor-config remedy addresses both. *** CORRECTED ~2335Z, TWICE, AND BOTH CORRECTIONS ARE TO MY OWN FRAMING *** (1) Labelling L1-L2 as 'MEMBERSHIP = 90.8% of the gap' was IMPRECISE: L1 is accrual+cash-inclusive and L2 is positions-grain, so L1-L2 mixes the missing-member term with the cash/accrual measure term. L1 and L3 are the like-for-like pair; the sound total is L1-L3 = $2,086,553,267.96. On the 24 exact-tie groups the roster agrees and L1-L3 is zero, so L1-L2 there is PURE BASIS and measures -$1,964,099.38 -- the measure term isolated with membership held at zero. I hold GROUP-GRAIN qt6 only, so a per-group membership-vs-basis split is NOT derivable from what I have and 90.8% must not be quoted as 'membership is 90.8% of the gap'. (2) OUR OWN COVERAGE IS NOT THE DRIVER, now tested rather than assumed: groups where our canonical covers every export member (90) have median +29.70% against +29.08% for the 109 with unmatched members -- indistinguishable, so the gap is upstream of our chain. Caveat kept attached: 'unmatched=0' means we cover every account THE EXPORT LISTS and says nothing about accounts BD has that the export never listed, which is the population in question -- supporting evidence, not proof. ROSTER DELTA MEASURED (not adjudicated): 15 groups in qt6 not in the export, combined Aug EMV $8,557,079.70, all person-shaped and all small; 1 in the export not in qt6 (Kate Gotta, L2 $612,921.73 / 3 accounts / L3 $0.00). THE TWO GAPS ARE NOT ADDITIVE and are reported separately: whole-missing-groups $8,557,079.70 is 0.45% of the within-group shortfall $1,895,250,943.98, so the story is members missing INSIDE groups we already have, not missing groups.

mutant.description: TWO mutants run against the shipped tool. M1: reduce _zfill10 to identity, breaking the 8-vs-10-digit account join between the BD export (8-digit Original Account Number) and our gold canonical (10-digit account_id). M2: bypass dedupe_group_account, the call the docstring credited with preventing per-group double-counting. M2 was re-run after the supervision-sleeve correction; see observed.
mutant.expected: M1: if the join is load-bearing, L3 must collapse to ~0 matched accounts -- a wrong-width join returns a clean confident ZERO rather than an error. M2: if the dedup call is what prevents double-counting, the Travis book figure must move from $392,556,451.10 toward the $405,399,972.00 raw row sum, and other groups must move too.
mutant.observed: M1 FIRED DECISIVELY: L3 collapsed from 284 matched / $377,433,506.75 to 0 matched / $0.00. M2 (dedup bypassed) NOW FIRES TOO: 79 of 201 group books change, total |delta| $206,733,899.92 (Travis inflates $392,556,451.10 -> the $405,399,972.00 raw row sum). RE-RUN AND UPDATED 2026-08-19 ~2245Z. At the vintage first reported, M2 correctly DID NOT FIRE (0 of 201, |delta| $0.00) because the account-collapse was done by build_membership's dict keying. The SUPERVISION-SLEEVE CORRECTION changed the mechanism: sleeves are now SUMMED rather than collapsed by dict keying, so dedupe_group_account became the only thing standing between the book and the raw row sum. THE TRANSFERABLE POINT: a mutant result is a statement about the code AT A VINTAGE, not a permanent property -- change what is being aggregated and every control over that aggregation must be re-run, or you carry a stale verdict about your own instrument. The docstring was corrected twice accordingly; both corrections are in the deliverable's ADDENDUM.
